g.text: Dietary scores relate to distinct aspects of meal responses
All seven scores retained • Original and joint samples overlap • Pointwise 95% confidence intervals
Filled: q < 0.05; open: q ≥ 0.05. A–B: original 70-test family per sample. C–D: original 14-test families.
D compares carbohydrate-associated changes at score Q75 versus Q25; carbohydrate anchors vary by score and sample.
D is neither an absolute between-group glucose difference nor the total carbohydrate slope. Do not rank scores by D.
